lore: The Queen Mother of the West oversees matters of life and death, prosperity and calamity. Since the Shattering, she is one of Tian’s busiest gods, working to repair the many aspects of Ryven that remain out of balance. She communes with emperors and heroes, granting fortune—and in rare cases, immortality—to those who prove helpful in her efforts.
